_about: Problems the engine has hit, the log line that gives each away, and the fix. `clipengine diagnose` matches recent logs against these. Add an entry whenever a new problem is solved.

problems.match: Tunnel connection failed: 403|segment download failed from|no reachable live playlist
problems.problem: This machine can't reach a Twitch video server (network or firewall rules).
problems.fix: Run the engine on a machine with normal internet access; on a restricted network, allow *.ttvnw.net hosts. Streams offline also show this.

problems.problem: The poster's Chrome is signed out of YouTube.
problems.fix: The user signs in once: cd engine && node post.mjs --login, then node post.mjs --check.

problems.problem: The poster's Chrome is signed out of TikTok.
problems.fix: The user signs in once: cd engine && node post.mjs --login.

problems.match: logged in, but not as|not logged in to Instagram|instagram.com/accounts/login
problems.problem: Instagram is signed out or signed in to a different account.
problems.fix: Sign in to the account in brand/brand.json: cd engine && node post.mjs --login.

problems.problem: The poster is signed in to a different account than the brand pack names.
problems.fix: Either sign in to the right account (node post.mjs --login) or correct the handles in brand/brand.json.

problems.match: no TikTok username in brand|no handle in brand
problems.problem: The brand pack is missing account handles.
problems.fix: clipengine init --force with --youtube --instagram --tiktok, or edit brand/brand.json.

problems.match: engine Chrome did not start|Chrome not found
problems.problem: Google Chrome isn't installed where the poster looks.
problems.fix: Install Google Chrome, or set CLIPENGINE_CHROME to its path.

problems.match: No space left on device|only \d+ GB free
problems.problem: The disk is full or nearly full.
problems.fix: clipengine cycle clears old drafts; stop a sentinel (clipengine stop --channel X) or lower buffer_h in config/ops.json.

problems.problem: This machine can't push to the repo.
problems.fix: git pull, then push again; if it still fails, the machine needs push access to the repo.

problems.match: PUBLISH REFUSED: title uses|headline wraps to|quote too long
problems.problem: The headline breaks a rule (risky wording or too long).
problems.fix: Rewrite it per brand/voice.md: true to the cut, under ~80 characters, no violence or sexual words.

problems.problem: The clip was refused as sexual content.
problems.fix: Skip this moment; censoring words doesn't make it safe.
Run bash setup/setup.sh (checks ffmpeg); if it repeats on one source, skip that moment and report it with clipengine support.

problems.problem: Twitch's data service returned an error.
problems.fix: Usually temporary: the next cycle retries. If it persists for an hour, run clipengine update and report it.

problems.problem: The poster held a clip (bad title, not vertical, too long, or not marked brand-safe).
problems.fix: Read the reason on that log line; re-publish the clip fixed. Held clips are in failed/.

problems.problem: A sentinel's recorder keeps restarting (stream offline, or its video server unreachable).
problems.fix: If the streamer is live, see host-blocked; otherwise cycle stops the sentinel when they go offline.
